## 🏗️ System Blueprint Overview: "Research Paper Intelligence Platform"
- [ ] **Ingestion Pipeline:** Ingest raw arXiv streams in your CDSE sub-field utilizing a robust Prefect or Airflow pipeline
- [ ] **Data Versioning:** Fully wrap features and dataset versions via strict DVC configuration rules
- [ ] **Fine-Tuning Loop:** Native PyTorch or PEFT/QLoRA model modification loop tracking experiments via MLflow
- [ ] **Storage Indexing:** Set up a RAG system indexing outputs dynamically into Chroma or Weaviate databases
- [ ] **High-Throughput Serving:** Wrap the model inside a FastAPI gateway scaled by a high-performance vLLM engine
- [ ] **Orchestration:** Deploy the production layer onto local or cloud Kubernetes clusters guarded with active health metrics
- [ ] **CI/CD Execution:** Create end-to-end automation via GitHub Actions to handle image building, testing, and formatting
- [ ] **Observability:** Hook up Evidently AI tracking loops to continuously audit distribution drift and push performance alerts

## 📦 Required Deliverables
- [ ] Public GitHub repository with comprehensive architecture layouts and visual demos (GIF/video)
- [ ] 1-2 page executive report detailing layout tradeoffs, system limitations, and design iterations
- [ ] Active live deployment running on Hugging Face Spaces or Streamlit Community Cloud

## 🏁 Operational Checkpoint
- [ ] **Verification:** Can you confidently whiteboard this entire architecture from scratch in 5 minutes, including the single design pattern you would change given additional compute time?
